exposure: Women requiring operative vaginal delivery or emergency cesarean section
Gestational age at or beyond 40 weeks
cohort: Normotensive pregnant women with a singleton, normally grown, non-anomalous fetus between 37 and 42 weeks gestation
finding: Maternal PlGF levels decrease significantly during labor, with a median decrease of nearly one quarter.
mod_finding: Women who required operative vaginal delivery or emergency cesarean section had lower median PlGF levels at both time-points and a greater drop in PlGF during labor compared to those who had spontaneous vaginal deliveries, but these differences were not statistically significant.
